{{Top|leg}}
The '''Waker's Dance''' was a dance performed by [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'leks]] as part of the [[Festival of Awakening]]. In [[3644 BBY]] [[Nalen Raloch]] did the dance with the rest of the Twi'lek settlers in the [[Kalikori village]] on [[Tython/Legends|Tython]].<ref name="SWTOR">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
Waker's Dance is mentioned in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' during the Consular class mission on Tython.
